content: Nasal congestion refers to the obstruction of the nasal passages, which typically occurs due to the swelling of the membranes lining the nose. This swelling is caused by inflammation of the blood vessels within the nasal tissues. Nasal congestion is also commonly referred to as nasal blockage, nasal obstruction, blocked nose, runny nose, or stuffy nose. Contrary to popular belief, nasal congestion is not primarily caused by an excessive accumulation of thick mucus. Instead, in most cases, it results from the swelling of the tissues lining the nasal passages. This swelling is a consequence of inflamed blood vessels in the nasal tissue. For diagnostic purposes, imaging studies such as X-rays of the sinuses and chest may be utilized. In certain cases, a CT scan of the sinuses is necessary to confirm the diagnosis.
